_about: Inputs of the Gem value table (/tools/gems/, F-21). VIP Shop rows come from the A04-vip-shop table (A04-0007) and City Hall gems from A01-city-hall-rewards (A01-0002) at build time.

apPerPurchase.unit: AP per gem purchase (Intermediate Action Point Recovery)

apStartPrice.unit: gems for the first purchase of the day

apStep.unit: gems more for each next purchase that day

evidence.A04-0008: rises by 50 gems per purchase, resetting to 100 gems at the daily server reset

wheelTenSpins.unit: gems for the first 10 spins (old gem pricing)

evidence.A11-0503: usually stop at 10 spins (best value, ~5,600 gems)
evidence.C04-0022: Wheel of Fortune spins require Spin Tickets bought with Gems or bundles

guidance.text: Free gems go to VIP points first: VIP 6, then VIP 10.

evidence.A04-0009: Guides agree F2P gems should go first to VIP points (VIP 6, then VIP 10)
evidence.A11-0504: F2P gem priority starts with VIP (VIP 6, then VIP 10)

guidance.text: Spend them during More Than Gems, a 2-day event with daily gem-spend milestones (except below VIP 6).

evidence.A11-0502: More Than Gems (2-day event with daily gem-spend milestones) is the best window for F2P to spend gems (except below VIP 6)
evidence.A04-0009: ideally be spent during the 'More Than Gems' event for bonus rewards

guidance.text: Don't finish buildings or research instantly with gems.

evidence.A11-0504: avoid gems for finishing timers, teleports, most VIP-shop items

guidance.text: Books of Covenant (needed for City Hall 25): guides disagree on buying them with gems.

evidence.A04-0009: They disagree on buying Books of Covenant (10 gems each)
evidence.A11-0504: then Books of Covenant (needed for CH25)

guidance.text: One guide says not to spend gems on VIP at all; most say the opposite.

evidence.A04-0009: and on spending gems on VIP at all (AllClash)
